unresolved: Whether Table 2 solid-food values are on the dried (80 °C) or as-purchased basis; no moisture data given.

disposition_reason: Retail market survey of 143 foodstuffs bought in Mexico City; Table 2 reports Cd means (duplicate determinations of one item each) for four in-scope cocoa/chocolate items: cocoa powder 0.289, chocolate powder 0.117, chocolate bars 0.060 and dark chocolate bars 0.029 mg/kg. Cd only; no Pb or other analytes.
disposition_locator: Table 2 (Snacks, sweets, and desserts), PDF p.9; Results 3.1 p.4; Methods 2 and 2.2 pp.2-3

study.design: market survey (cross-sectional food monitoring) with theoretical dietary intake
study.material_scope: retail cocoa powder, chocolate powder, chocolate bars, dark chocolate bars (one foodstuff item each)
study.growing_origin_vs_market: purchased in retail outlets in Mexico City; growing origin of cocoa not reported
study.sampling_unit: one retail foodstuff item per listed product (143 foodstuffs overall), Cd determined in duplicate per item and averaged
study.method: Graphite-furnace AAS (PerkinElmer AAnalyst 600, HGA-600, AS800); HNO3 digestion in 60 °C water bath per NOM-117-SSA1-1994; standard addition for non-perishable foods
study.lod_loq: Cd LoQ 0.5 µg/L in digest solution (lowest calibration point); no matrix mg/kg LoQ reported
study.basis: Solid items dehydrated at 80 °C for 72 h before grinding and digestion; the paper does not state whether reported mg/kg are on the dried or as-purchased basis
study.qa: NIST 1577c bovine liver internal control every 30 samples, recovery 100.9 ± 13.6%; repeatability CV 13.9% at LoQ, 1.8-7.8% at other levels
